name: Hopkins Prairie Surrounding Dispersed Camping - Ocala National Forest

management_agency.name: U.S. Forest Service - Seminole Ranger District

rules_and_regulations.cost: 100% Free in general forest dispersed zones (outside developed fee area during non-hunting season)
rules_and_regulations.guidelines: Dispersed primitive camping permitted on general national forest lands at least 100ft from marked trails and water bodies. Camping restricted to designated sites during general gun hunting season.

waste_disposal_rules.poop_disposal: Dig cat-hole 6 inches deep in sandy soil layer, at least 200 feet from prairies or springs. Pack out toilet paper.
waste_disposal_rules.trash_policy: Strict Leave No Trace. Black bears present: food storage container or vehicle hard-side storage mandatory.

campfire_rules.firewood_policy: Dead and down wood gathering permitted.
campfire_rules.safety_requirements: Clear dry pine needles 10 feet around fire ring. Extinguish cold to touch.
campfire_rules.seasonal_fire_bans: Obey Florida Forest Service burn bans during dry winter/spring periods.

access_and_road_conditions.road_conditions: Flat sandy roads; can become soft deep sand in hot dry weather.
access_and_road_conditions.vehicle_recommendation: Normal low clearance car (accessible on main graded forest roads; high clearance / 4x4 recommended for deep sand side spurs)

seasonal_weather_effects.spring: 75-85°F warm days, low rainfall, pleasant sub-tropical breezes.
seasonal_weather_effects.summer: Hot and humid (90-95°F), heavy afternoon downpours, high mosquito / yellow fly activity.
seasonal_weather_effects.fall: Warm 75-85°F, lower humidity, excellent primitive camping conditions.
seasonal_weather_effects.winter: Premier winter escape (65-75°F daytime, 45-55°F nights), dry clear skies.

dangers_and_hazards: Florida Black Bears (Ursus americanus floridanus) - bear-proof food storage mandatory
Eastern Diamondback Rattlesnakes and Pygmy Rattlesnakes
Loose deep soft sand capable of trapping low-clearance 2WD vehicles
Mosquitoes and ticks near prairie wetlands

common_human_made_sounds: Distant motorboat on Lake George (3 miles east)
Occasional Navy jet training flyover from Ocala Bombing Range

human_demographics_and_culture: Winter snowbird vanlifers, Florida National Scenic Trail backpackers, off-grid nomads, and local hunters.

spiritual_and_folklore_data.nature_spirits_and_mythological_lore: Timucua and Seminole indigenous oral histories revere the hidden freshwater springs and scrub prairies of Ocala as sacred healing waters guarded by forest spirits.
spiritual_and_folklore_data.energetic_and_spiritual_features: Sub-tropical pine flatwoods grounding energy, exceptional winter warmth, clear starry nights.

nearby_hiking_trails.trail_name: Florida National Scenic Trail (Hopkins Prairie Segment)
nearby_hiking_trails.features: Winding sandy trail along prairie edge, oak hammocks, longleaf pine savannah

public_reviews_summary: Top choice for winter boondocking in Florida. Beautiful pine flatwoods scenery and dependable cell internet.
other_data: Bortle Class 3 night sky. High solar power panel output.
